- Improve “little thyme,” a recipe generator that recommends recipes based on kitchen ingredients.

## Requirements
- Include more recipes.
- Don’t link to recipe websites; show the full recipe in the app.

## Decisions
- Keep TheMealDB for online recipe results and built-in recipes as a fallback.
- Show full ingredients and instructions in the recipe modal without an external recipe link.

- `screenshots/app.jpg`: Existing review screenshot.

- Changes are uncommitted; project files appear as untracked in `git status`.
- The MealDB online search previously worked in browser testing.
